name: The person's own notes reach the brief, little else, nothing outside the scope
purpose: The notes a request needs from the person's saved notes about their focus are in the brief, with few others, and no note outside the person's scope is shown; a request about something else gets next to nothing.
record: Twenty invented neutral cases (evaluation/focus_context/build_cases.py, source tag invented-neutral): a fictional vegetable garden focus with its notes, a distractor folder of kitchen notes that share its words (tomato, bean, bed, plant, practice), a neighbour's notes in another scope and unrelated notes; five kinds (named_word, own_practice, fenced, unrelated, cross_focus) over four crops, the last crop held out. Per case: utility = 0.60 recall + 0.25 tidiness + 0.15 safety, weights fixed before any arm was scored; a case passes at recall 1, safety 1 and tidiness 0.5 or more. No model call. The real entry point is covered by one fast-tier run of ahohs work on a pseudo-terminal, recorded in the README of the solution.
disadvantages: Invented cases written by the arm's author: real notes are less tidy; it scores which notes reach the brief, not whether a model's answer uses them; one case (a build request whose word check matches a rose note) fails and is kept as the finding.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arms that call no model were recorded on the same cases] > real [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=a person authorized one fast-tier run of the terminal]
command: esoi run focus_context --impl no_context; esoi run focus_context --impl filesystem_search; esoi run focus_context --impl configured_focus_context
